decision: Selected the Texas 9-1-1 address point (source CSEC) that the statewide TxGIO StratMap address service publishes for 1356 FM 488, Fairfield, Freestone County, the location address registered with the Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation for CyrusOne building DFW20A (shell TABS2026026013 and fit-out TABS2026026904, owner C1 Freestone 1, LLC), as the campus locator.

facts.note_1366: 1366 FM 488 is the Freestone Energy Center address that CyrusOne gives on its Freestone County page; its CSEC point is 1208.7 m from the 1356 point.
facts.output_coordinate_system: The service returned WGS84 (wkid 4326) with outSR=4326; coordinates rounded to 7 decimals (about 1 cm).
facts.appraisal_parcel_context: In the TxGIO StratMap land-parcel layer (Freestone Appraisal District data, DATE_ACQ serial 46174) the 1356 point lies inside parcel PROP_ID 15693 (legal 16.075 acres, GIS 63.49 acres, situs FM 488) whose owner is a private individual (name not recorded). An envelope identify of 115 parcels around both points returns no parcel owned by C1 Freestone 1, CL Freestone 1 or CyrusOne; the nearest Freestone Power Generation LLC / FPEC LLC parcel is 273 m from the 1356 point, and the 1366 point (no containing parcel; probably road right of way) lies about 1 m from a Freestone Power Generation LLC parcel. The data-centre land is therefore not identifiable in the appraisal snapshot, and the address point may mark the site access on FM 488 rather than the buildings.
